titles.a: Man City Were Found Guilty On 114 Charges. What Happens Now?
titles.b: Can Man City Be Relegated After 114 Guilty Charges?

intro: A Premier League independent commission found Manchester City guilty of 114 of 115 charges, reported on 25 September and confirmed on 29 September 2026. City dispute the finding and have appealed. This video goes through the five groups of charges, what the commission found, City's response, the appeal, and what sanctions could follow, using only what the cited reports say.
disclaimer: The charges are against the club. No individual is found guilty. Figures come from the cited news reports and the Premier League table of 27 November 2026. Where reports disagree (the date of the league's statement) the video says only what two reports share. Sanctions have not been decided and the video does not predict them. Match footage and news clips are short, muted and used with commentary; owners are named on screen.
